start_here: Say to your AI: "Make the review pack for option x00-r8-2 of my film in /films/made-up-film: contact sheets and a timed transcript of its working preview." It runs review_pack.py and hands the pack folder to the fresh-viewer review.

lists.label: Settings
lists.holds: One row per tool and scope (a person, a film, a piece or the whole account): the settings that tool reads when it runs, as JSON.

instructions: 1. Pour the two example setting rows into your own settings list (see pour); preview.review_pack in the film's row sets every_s, per_sheet, width, model and language.
2. Have the option's working preview in work-round-<n>/working/ (or name another file as video).
3. Say what you said in start_here. Your AI reads the row with tools:list and runs `python3 tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/do-work/review_pack.py /films/made-up-film/request.json`.

4. Read the last JSON line: the sheets, the tile count and the transcript line count. Hand the pack folder to tool:check-a-rendered-video's fresh-viewer review without summarizing the preview yourself.

worked_examples.title: A 13.5 second working preview becomes two contact sheets and a three-line transcript
worked_examples.ask: Make the fresh-viewer review pack for option x00-r8-2.
worked_examples.given: From tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/test/test_filmcraft_preview.py (the_review_pack_has_sheets_and_a_transcript), run for real with ffmpeg, Pillow and the test's stand-in Whisper (test/stand_in_whisper). work-round-8/working/x00-r8-2.mp4 is a 13.5 second 320x180 test pattern with a sine tone. The AI runs `python3 tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/do-work/review_pack.py /films/made-up-film/request.json` with request.json = {"film":"/films/made-up-film","option":"x00-r8-2","settings":{...}}. The stand-in Whisper's words are made up; a real run hears the real preview.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result":{"pack":"/films/made-up-film/cuts/options-one/work-round-8/review-pack/x00-r8-2","sheets":[".../sheet-01.jpg",".../sheet-02.jpg"],"tiles":14,"lines":3,"scratch":"/films/made-up-film/cuts/options-one/work-round-8/working/rp-<random>"}} and transcript.txt holds "00:00 Made up words.", "00:01 A question?" and "00:02 No end", one per line. With video set to /made/up.mp4 it answers an error that says there is no preview at that path.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
